name: Tertiary Kesmere
description: Tertiary Kesmere was a cloudy, storm-wracked world located in the Tertiary Kesmere system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the winged hornagaunt species, including the wing-clipped pet Grendel. Between 4 ABY and 12 ABY, Tertiary Kesmere fell within the borders of the Pentastar Alignment.
